mu_name_from: Noria's object slot 19, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object4/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under an nr_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing for the reason the ground's is: assets/textures is one flat pool for every world, and yellow_jewel.png was already taken by an item.
material_note: wd: yellow-green fronds, drawn additively - glowing leaves.
additive_from: ZzzObject.cpp, CreateObject, case WD_3NORIA: `o->BlendMesh = 0` for type 19, and the render path draws that submesh with RENDER_BRIGHT. Mesh order is the .bmd's, which is the order the .obj groups are in.
